summary: Advance the Ghost Ship template and module version to 0.3.5 so existing 0.3.4 scenes run the single-background cleanup and dynamic-light migration, then publish through the normal Foundry release workflow.

checks.name: Manifest version
checks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.5') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.5');"
